issue.title: Bank setup Ctrl+K group jump stays on category:groceries in real Obsidian
issue.description: Ctrl+K should select a group: scope but remains category:groceries. Bank setup is 46/47 on final kit and clean 946ef56. Full reproduction, isolated runner, logs and screenshots are in file:explicit:a50033287bd8564938d9063a clean-base/bank-setup and reproduce-clean-base.sh. Use checkout-built bob with BOB_CLI_DIR, BOB_BIN, explicit BOB_LEDGER_TOOLS_PLUGIN_DIR, TMPDIR=/tmp and xvfb-run -a. Isolate the runner hardcoded /tmp/bse2e path to avoid CDP ownership collisions. Diagnose focus/dispatch versus navigation; preserve true Ctrl+K semantics. No proven root cause, so large. Related mk is additional arrangement walkthrough coverage, not this existing failure.
